from kb_test_request_presets p left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = p.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:

order by p.id desc

mapper.update:

name = #{name}, protocol_code = #{protocolCode},
logical_model_code = #{logicalModelCode}, request_body = #{requestBody}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status},
